name: Door and Window Numbering by Zone
summary: Gives every door and window an ID built from its zone, such as 1.04-D1, numbered clockwise within each zone, in the Element ID or a property.

versions.changelog: Uses the current Element ID as {id} in the patterns, lets you choose which zone side comes first ("To zone" now follows Archicad's To Zone property), writes to the Element ID or a text property, and can number repeated IDs (.01, .02, ...).
First version in the marketplace, the same as the built-in script of the same name.
